findings.claim: warnedUnclassifiedLinkIds is a new ad hoc in-process memo with no cron clear and no size bound, so it holds one entry per unclassified trial-link id for the lifetime of the process and will never re-warn if a catalog issue is fixed and later re-broken.

The rewritten assertion uses a bare toThrow(), which passes for any thrown error including a TypeError from an unrelated typo in the code under test, unlike the sibling case in billing.service.spec.ts which pins the specific error message.
